passages.note: House Third Reading vote on the single-subject ESA bill; Payne voted Y.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: New §15-2401.01 extends ESA eligibility to any resident eligible for public school who does not already qualify, enacting universal eligibility.
Bill status page lists Payne as a co-sponsor of HB2853.

rows.reasoning: As a State Representative, Payne co-sponsored HB2853 (2022) and voted Y on its House Third Reading (31-26-3-0-0); the bill added ARS 15-2401.01, making any Arizona resident eligible to enroll in public school (preschool for disabilities, kindergarten, or grades 1-12) who does not otherwise qualify a 'qualified student' eligible for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account beginning the 2022-2023 school year. This matches 'Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family'; per the V5 earlier-chamber ruling his House-term record on this single-subject bill counts as in-term for his current Senate seat in the same legislature.
